summary.name: iSlide
summary.one_liner: iSlide is an AI-powered PowerPoint design tool offering one-click deck generation, a large library of PPT templates and assets, and dozens of one-click slide optimization functions.
use_cases: generating a full slide deck from text
downloading licensed PowerPoint templates and graphics
optimizing layout and design of existing slides
building internal presentation template libraries for a company
summary.what_it_does: The page describes iSlide as an AI-assisted PPT design tool that can generate a presentation from scratch from text, including editing the outline and switching template styles with one click. It advertises over 5 million genuine PPT templates and materials for download and 86 one-click PPT optimization functions. The page also describes enterprise and partner deployments: an embedded resource library for third-party sites, and a Docker-deployed version with offline functionality and SSO/OA login integration for organizations. Partners named include Quark Docs, Microsoft OfficePLUS, and Aerospace Cloud Network.
notable: over 5 million licensed PPT templates and materials
enterprise deployment via Docker with offline mode and SSO/OA login integration
partnerships with Quark Docs and Microsoft OfficePLUS
caveats: Pricing and paid tiers are not stated on the page
Page is mostly partner testimonials and marketing; few technical details are given
Listing describes it as a plugin, but the page does not name specific PowerPoint or OS platforms
